product: Connect Grok Bot/Cursor to Genie One with the Databricks Genie plugin
tagline: The Databricks Genie plugin connects Grok Bot/Cursor to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from Grok Bot/Cursor.
what_it_does: The Databricks Genie plugin connects Grok Bot/Cursor to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from Grok Bot/Cursor. A Cursor team admin publishes the plugin for the team, and each user connects by signing in with their Databricks account. The Genie One MCP server is a Databricks provided MCP that exposes Genie as a conversational tool over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), leveraging Chat in Genie One.
why_it_matters: Genie resolves business terms, metric definitions, and table relationships through Genie Ontology, your governed semantic layer, which produces more accurate answers than an agent writing SQL directly against raw tables.
